blocks.title: Earth's energy budget
blocks.text: Zameen ka energy budget zameen ki absorb ki hui Sooraj ki energy aur zameen ki wapas space mein radiate ki hui (bheji hui) energy ke darmiyan balance (barabari) hai.

Yeh batata hai ke Sooraj ki kitni energy zameen tak aati hai aur us mein se kitni reflection (lautne) aur emission (bahar nikalne) se wapas space mein chali jati hai. Jab zameen thandi hoti hai to surface par zyada ice aur snow (barf) hoti hai. Barf chamakdar hai aur bohat si dhoop wapas space mein reflect kar deti hai, jis se zameen aur thandi ho jati hai. Lekin jab zameen garam hoti hai to barf pighalne lagti hai. Is se neeche ki dark (gehre rang ki) zameen aur samandar khul jate hain, jo zyada dhoop absorb karte aur kam reflect karte hain; nateeja: zameen aur garam hoti hai. Aane aur jane wali energy ke isi balance ko zameen ka energy budget kehte hain, aur yeh zameen ka temperature steady (aik jaisa) rakhne mein aham hai. Fig. 21.12 zameen ke energy budget ka diagram hai. Is mein dikhaya gaya hai ke dhoop zameen ki surface aur atmosphere tak kaise pohanchti hai. Sooraj se aane wali energy, zameen se infrared (garmi ki) radiation ki shakal mein jane wali energy ke barabar hoti hai. Jab tak yeh balance qaim rahe, zameen ka temperature waqt ke saath aik jaisa rehta hai. Lekin greenhouse gases (jaise carbon dioxide aur methane) infrared radiation ko trap kar leti hain (phansa leti hain) aur space mein jane nahi deti. Is wajah se zameen garam ho rahi hai; is masle ko global warming kehte hain.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Zameen tak aane wali Sooraj ki energy ka sirf taqreeban 70% zameen absorb karti hai; baqi badal, barf aur desert (registan) ki surfaces wapas space mein reflect kar dete hain. Is budget mein sirf 1% ka imbalance (barabari ka bigarna) bhi duniya ke temperature mein bari tabdeeli la sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Aasmani neele background par safaid EARTH'S ENERGY BUDGET. Dhoop seedhi zameen ki surface tak aati hai, aur aik shaakh badal tak (Absorption of Solar Radiation by Atmosphere). Surface se: Convection and Conduction, Evaporation aur Latent Heat, space aur atmosphere ki taraf infrared. Atmosphere se: space aur zameen ki taraf infrared. blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen hissa batata hai ke surface energy kaise khoti hai (convection aur conduction, evaporation se latent heat, aur infrared), aur daen hissa ke surface energy kaise pati hai (dhoop, aur atmosphere se wapas aane wali infrared). Khali boxes kitab ne is liye chhore hain ke un mein energy ki amount likhi ja sake. Jab absorb ki hui dhoop space mein jane wali infrared ke barabar ho to temperature steady rehta hai; greenhouse gases zyada infrared wapas zameen ki taraf bhejein to zameen garam hoti hai.
